headline: Walmart Q3 Revenue Rises 5.2% to $188.8 Billion, Raising Full-Year Outlook
summary: Walmart reported Q3 revenue of $188.84 billion, up 5.2% and beating estimates. The retailer raised its full-year guidance while warning of potential headwinds from rising fuel expenses.
why: Walmart is the world's largest retail merchant by revenue, operating hypermarkets, discount stores, and grocery outlets globally.

impacts.name: Walmart
impacts.why: Strong Q3 revenue growth and raised full-year sales guidance boosted market expectations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Quarterly sales figures surpassed analyst forecasts, prompting management to raise full-year earnings forecasts.
